verdict.rationale: Firstbase is a SaaS that holds sensitive company, banking and mail data, so user control over data retention and deletion is a fair axis for it. The evidence pack never mentions retention settings, deletion requests, account or data erasure, or retention policies. Mentions of secure mail scanning and secure partner data sharing are adjacent and do not count as retention or deletion controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
